title: Guling Street Avant-garde Theatre
geometryBasis: Named OSM way 314806410 carries the theatre’s address, three-floor tag and Wikidata identity. The survey retains the five-point envelope and the distinctive northwest-facing clipped corner.
sectionBasis: The operator describes the original two-storey Japanese-style brick street block and three-floor rear workshop wing. Taipei’s rehabilitation record describes the Art Deco on both street-facing sides and preservation of the historic station. Peter Bronski’s cleared photograph establishes the ribbed corner, projecting balcony and grouped windows.
limitations: The 2008 public-domain photo pre-dates the city-funded rehabilitation. Post-restoration surface colors are approximated from municipal descriptive text. Rear opening counts, parapet heights, canopy depth and side trim are estimated.
The model follows the retained historic building and street entry. Interiors, surrounding tenancies, street signs and machinery are outside the selected exterior scope.
